tools.name: search_sellers
tools.description: Find paid x402 data services AI agents can buy, inside one category, ranked. Use before paying any seller.

category.description: category slug or its name in any of 19 languages, e.g. crypto-prices, 加密货币价格, 暗号資産の価格, cotización cripto (see list_categories)

q.description: text to match in name or address

sort.description: accuracy ranks by the low end of the 95% range of paid answers judged correct

tools_honoured.description: AI chat sellers only: keep those whose checked calls passed an agent's tools to the model and never dropped them

min_accuracy.description: keep sellers whose 95% range of correct paid answers starts at or above this share (0 to 1)

tools.name: check_seller
tools.description: Our latest independent check of one paid seller, by its address (any spelling) or id: answering, price, buyers, and its paid answers checked against an independent record (with proof).

tools.name: sellers_on_domain
tools.description: Every paid seller we check on one host.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every category of paid service agents buy, with sellers, buyers and how we check it; names in your language with lang.

tools.name: check_website
tools.description: Can AI agents use this shopping or travel website? Plain-agent access, each AI agent at the door, robots rules, llms.txt, history.

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Check up to 25 sellers and 25 websites in one call (cheapest for many checks).

tools.name: changes
tools.description: What changed since a day — keep a local copy in sync.

tools.name: find_route
tools.description: Where to go for a job, before you spend tokens on trial and error: the best tested free official source with its exact call and how much it returns (and a fallback). Ask in plain words, e.g. 'UK company directors', 'Apple revenue', 'EU gas storage'. detail=full adds the paid sellers we rate and other sources.

q.description: what you need, in plain words

country.description: optional ISO 3166 two-letter country code to prefer sources for that country, e.g. GB, US, DE

detail.description: full = also the paid sellers, registry-listed sources and other sources (a strong match otherwise returns the route alone)

tools.name: list_websites
tools.description: Rated websites, filtered by market (e.g. 'United States', 'Japan'), plain-agent outcome (open, blocked, timeout) or price honesty (does the price agents read match what people see).

prices.description: price honesty on product, event or stay pages: keep sites with at least one page in this state

detail.description: full = per-agent tables for every site (else counts; check_website has the tables)
